purpose: Minimal source compliance catalog for the public Metrixx-AI ingestion subset.

status_definitions.GO: Full ingestion, normalization, validation, and derived analytics are allowed.
status_definitions.GO_INTERNAL_ANALYTICS: Internal analytics only; do not redistribute raw licensed reference data.
status_definitions.REVIEW_PARAPHRASE_ONLY: Headline/snippet event detection only; no full article fetch, storage, or reproduction.
status_definitions.HOLD: Blocked until licensing or explicit AI/data-use rights are approved.
